custom_fields.label: Folder
custom_fields.description: The mailbox folder it is in, by its name on the server, or INBOX, Sent, Archive, Junk or Trash for an address on the mail domain.
custom_fields.name: Communication-one_folder

custom_fields.label: Thread
custom_fields.description: The Message-ID of the first message in its conversation.
custom_fields.name: Communication-one_thread

custom_fields.label: Original
custom_fields.description: Where the message as it arrived is kept, for an address on the mail domain.
custom_fields.name: Communication-one_raw_key

custom_fields.label: Not Saved
custom_fields.description: Attachments that arrived while storage was full. They are saved once there is room.
custom_fields.name: Communication-one_unsaved

custom_fields.label: Sender Verified
custom_fields.description: The receiving server confirmed the sender's address, because DMARC passed, or DKIM or SPF passed for the sender's own domain.
custom_fields.name: Communication-one_verified

custom_fields.label: Risk
custom_fields.description: How risky the message looked when it arrived, from 0 to 100, by its sender's checks, its links and its attachments.
custom_fields.name: Communication-one_risk

custom_fields.label: Held
custom_fields.description: Kept out of its folder and run through no rule until someone who uses the mailbox releases it.
custom_fields.name: Communication-one_held
